question: Who was the first president of the All-India Trade Union Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lala Lajpat Rai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **country’s first national trade union, All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC), turns 100 on October 30, 2020**.
 
• The first Congress of AITUC was held on **October 31, 1920, in Bombay**.
 
• AITUC was** founded by Lala Lajpat Rai**.
 
• AITUC was formed under** Indian National Congress**.
 
• Presently Governed by **President – Ramendra Kumar and General Secretary – Amarjeet Kaur**.
 
• Other leaders who participated in AITUC were:
 
 
• **Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose.**
 
• **V. V. Giri, Sarojini Naidu.**
 
• **C.R. Das, Jawarharlal Nehru.**
 
• **Mohammad Ali Jinnah.**
 
• **N. M. Joshi**
 
• Joseph Baptista.</strong
